name: Video Opener
description: Full-screen hero with a fanned row of polaroid-style photo cards and a play button that expands the middle card into a full-screen video player with a close button.
contents: Up to three polaroid cards with image and caption
Watch button with loading spinner and error message
Full-screen video overlay with close button
Background image with tinted overlay and thick border
behavior: Cards tilt and lift on hover
Button appears once the video has loaded
Middle card expands to full screen, then the video fades and scales in and plays
Escape key, close button or video end collapses the player
Page scroll is locked while the video is open

props.name: errorLabel
props.default: The video could not be loaded.

editableByProps: Card images, alt text and captions (first three used)
Button, close, loading and error labels
Muted playback, background and text colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the expand and fade timing

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Locks body scroll while the video is open and restores it afterwards
Listens for the Escape key on window while the video is open
Uses Bodoni Moda and Hanken Grotesk through next/font/google, so it needs Next.js
